JianFeng.additionalInfo: An important point for treating breast disorders. Hu Wen Zhi Combine with Shaung Long to treat breast diseases. To enhance the effect, bleed the area of the lungs and heart on the back. Point Name Jiän [B] — shoulder. Féng [if] — peak, highest point. Jian Feng - acromion. The name of the point suggests its location beneath the acromion.
